title: Set application author name to WAMIQ AHMAD

requirements.text: Add the application author name as "WAMIQ AHMAD" in a visible place in the UI (About page footer/credits section) so users can see who authored the application.

quotes: add the author name for the application to WAMIQ AHMAD

acceptanceCriteria: On the About page, the footer/credits area displays the author name exactly as: "WAMIQ AHMAD".
The author name is readable on both light and dark themes and does not break the existing layout on mobile widths.

requirements.text: Add standard HTML metadata for the application author in the app HTML head with the value "WAMIQ AHMAD".

quotes: add the author name for the application to WAMIQ AHMAD

acceptanceCriteria: frontend/index.html includes a meta tag for author with content exactly "WAMIQ AHMAD".
No other existing meta tags (description, theme-color), title, or icons are removed.

constraints: Use English for any user-facing text.
Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui or other immutablePaths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
nonGoals: Do not change the app name ("Earth Eye"), logo, or other branding elements.
Do not add or change backend/canister logic for author information.
